notes:
• Clearer toggles. Switches in TabStation Settings, the Control Center popovers and the auto-brightness switch now show a solid accent color when on and a clear gray when off, with a white knob, like macOS and iOS. Before, the colors looked faded and on and off were hard to tell apart.

Requires Android 10+. Shizuku is recommended. Install over the previous version; settings are kept. TabStation updates itself from Settings → Version & updates.
